name: fortiui-unhider
description: A FortiGate WebUI bookmarklet that reveals hidden or scattered read-only configuration and runtime data.

scripts.test: node --check src/fortiui-unhider.js && node --check scripts/make-bookmarklet.js && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),vm=require('vm');const s=fs.readFileSync('dist/fortiui-unhider.bookmarklet.txt','utf8').trim();if(!s.startsWith('javascript:'))throw new Error('missing javascript prefix');new vm.Script(s.slice('javascript:'.length));"

author: Samuel Heinrich
